title: Water rocket
spec: PET bottle airframe · 3D-printed nose cone · servo parachute release
summary: A science competition rocket whose parachute didn't open, and four years of trying to do better: a clear bottle body, then a printed clamshell nose cone in grey, white and gold. It led to CAD, electronics, PCBs and AeroDesign. A timeline, mostly pictures.

cover.alt: The 3D-printed nose cone and body: the nose split open on its springs, and the loose half standing beside it
